question: Khelo India Winter Games started in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Winter Games:-**

 
 
• It is an initiative by the** Government of India **to **promote winter sports **in the country.
 
• The **first edition** of the Khelo India Winter Games was held in **Gulmarg, Jammu** **Kashmir **from **7th to 11th March 2020.**
 
• The games witnessed the participation of more than 900 athletes from 27 states and Union Territories, competing in 20 disciplines.
 
• The aim of the Khelo India initiative is to identify and nurture young talent in sports and provide them with the necessary infrastructure, coaching, and financial support to excel at the national and international levels.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Winter Games:-**

 
 
• It typically refers to sports events that are held during the winter season and involve sports and activities that are played on snow or ice.
 
• These events are often organized as international competitions, bringing together athletes from various countries to compete in a range of winter sports.
 
• The most prominent Winter Games event is the Winter Olympics, which is held every four years.
